verdict.rationale: The docs say traces can be exported via the UI or API, and self-hosting lets data stay on your own infrastructure, which eases leaving. Nothing in the evidence shows a complete export of all data or names an open export format. OpenTelemetry support covers sending traces in, not getting them out. Missing for 10: bulk export of all data types (datasets, experiments, feedback, prompts, dashboards), documented open export formats, a documented account-exit or migration path, and independent hands-on corroboration of exports.
